highlights: Rebuilt the company's public marketing website from a legacy hand-maintained static HTML codebase into a component-based SvelteKit 2 / Svelte 5 application — 12 prerendered routes, a token-driven design system and full dark mode — shipped launch-ready with a zero-warning ~3s production build.

Brought the site to WCAG 2.2 AA: raised brand text contrast from ~1.5:1 to 4.5:1+ with theme-aware design tokens, added keyboard and touch alternatives to pointer-only interactions, and gated every animation on prefers-reduced-motion.
Designed and built five interactive, data-accurate product demos — a drag-and-drop pipeline board, a live journey-planning SVG map and a 12-tab call card — each operable by mouse, touch and keyboard.
Cut the production payload with scripted dead-code and orphaned-asset audits, removing 115+ unused CSS rules (~19% of the global stylesheet) and 25+ legacy assets.

Reduced content publishing from hand-editing HTML to dropping in a single file by migrating 22 blog articles to a Markdown/mdsvex pipeline with frontmatter-driven listing, prerendering and client-side search.

Automated deployment by authoring the AWS CodeBuild pipeline (npm ci, SvelteKit build, artifact emission, CloudFront invalidation), moving hosting from manual file copying to full CI/CD on S3 and CloudFront.

Designed and built a self-hosted WireGuard VPN on AWS EC2 (Ubuntu/Graviton, Docker + WG-Easy) to give the team a single fixed egress IP for database whitelisting, replacing an unreliable commercial VPN.

Diagnosed a networking misconfiguration where an allocated Elastic IP was never attached to the instance — restoring stable single-address egress and removing a duplicate IPv4 charge — then hardened the deployment with short-lived credentials over root keys, admin-only firewall scoping and secrets kept out of source control.
Made the VPN reproducible with an idempotent Bash installer, cloud-init and Terraform, plus operations documentation covering setup, maintenance, disaster recovery and cross-account migration.

items: AWS (EC2, S3, CloudFront, CodeBuild, IAM, VPC)
